# Compute longest consecutive streak of "yes" for ate_homemade_meals
from datetime import datetime

# Build list of (date, status) sorted by date
entries = []
for title, status in homemade.items():
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Log -- YYYY-MM-DD"
    date_str = title.split('-- ')[1].strip()
    d = datetime.strptime(date_str, '%Y-%m-%d')
    entries.append((d, status))

entries.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

# Compute longest streak
max_streak = 0
current_streak = 0
for d, status in entries:
    if status == 'yes':
        current_streak += 1
        if current_streak > max_streak:
            max_streak = current_streak
    else:
        current_streak = 0

print(max_streak)
